## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] Files are processed **only on the device**: no uploads, no new network requests, no analytics.
- [ ] New or changed processing code has unit tests (`npm test`).
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] Heavy work runs in a Web Worker (or is otherwise kept off the UI thread).
- [ ] The UI works with a keyboard, on mobile, and in dark and light mode.
- [ ] New tools have a title, meta description and "How it works" FAQ in `meta.ts`.
